name: card-vortex
title: Card Vortex
description: A ring of link cards that fans out from the center of any element on hover, focus, or tap, each card curving into its place on the ring.

useCases: Revealing a handful of projects, case studies, or destinations around a logo, nav label, or button.
limitations: Best with five to ten cards. The ring overlays nearby content and is not clipped to its parent unless an ancestor hides overflow. Supply your own artwork; demo images are not installed.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme tokens --background, --foreground, --muted, --border, and --ring. Use a button or link as the trigger so the keyboard can reach it.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/card-vortex.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
